From: legal@growthpay.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Inquiry: new telemetry processor (IonGrid) — need evidence and routing details

Hi Marissa,

We're preparing a short procurement addendum ahead of our renewal and noticed a new processor listed in Redwood's most recent vendor roster: IonGrid (telemetry / observability layering). Can you confirm whether IonGrid will be processing any customer data tied to GrowthPay production tokens, and if so provide:

- A short description of what telemetry is being sent (logs/metrics/trace/other).
- Countries where IonGrid processes or stores data.
- SOC 2 / security attestation or a pointer to a report (redacted is fine).
- Any subprocessor DPA addendum or flow for export / cross-border processing.
- Planned timeline for any cutovers and whether we can request a temporary opt-out.

We need this to close our procurement checklist — target date: 2028-06-25.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Senior Counsel, Procurement
GrowthPay

Subject: IonGrid onboarding evidence and dataflow for GrowthPay request

Hi Marissa/Team,

Thanks for the heads up. Quick responses to GrowthPay's checklist below (we've attached a short packet):

- Telemetry types: request-level anonymized metrics (latency/hits), aggregated application traces (sampling at 0.5%), and operational logs (no PII). No customer payloads are captured.
- Processing locations: primary processing in US (us-east-1), transient buffering in eu-west-1 for EU customers, no persistent storage in APAC.
- Attestations: SOC 2 Type II summary attached (redacted).
- Encryption & retention: TLS in flight; AES-256 at rest. Default retention for operational logs is 30 days; metrics/aggregates retained 365 days.
- DPA: we can sign a standard subprocessor addendum; IonGrid accepts DocuSign for subprocessor annexes.
- Cutover window: if you need to roll IonGrid in only for observability (no customer payload), we can schedule a phased onboarding with a 2-week opt-out window before retention becomes effective.

Attached: iongrid-soc2-summary.pdf, iongrid-dataflow-diagram.png. Also attaching our completed questionnaire (iongrid-questionnaire.pdf) that matches GrowthPay's ask.

If you'd like, I can join a quick call with GrowthPay next week to walk through the diagram.

Regards,
Lena Park
Head of Security Operations
IonGrid

Subject: RE: Inquiry: new telemetry processor (IonGrid) — confirmation & next steps

Hi Samira — thanks for the note and the deadline. Short answers and next steps below; see attached evidence from IonGrid.

- Will IonGrid process GrowthPay data? Yes — limited telemetry for observability only (anonymized metrics, sampled traces, and operational logs). No customer payloads or production tokens are forwarded.
- Processing countries: US primary (us-east-1) with transient buffering in EU (eu-west-1).
- Evidence: IonGrid provided a SOC 2 Type II summary (attached) and a dataflow diagram.
- DPA / subprocessor addendum: IonGrid will sign a subprocessor addendum; we can route a DocuSign link for GrowthPay's countersignature.
- Opt-out/mitigation: We can provide a two-week opt-out window (during which telemetry to IonGrid can be toggled off for your tenants) prior to enabling retention beyond 24 hours.

Action items for GrowthPay if you'd like to proceed:
1) Confirm whether GrowthPay requires the subprocessor addendum signed prior to cutover or will accept post-cutover countersignature within 5 business days.
2) If you prefer a call, we can set up a 30-minute walkthrough with IonGrid security next week; I'm free Tue/Wed afternoon PST.

Link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/DocuSign/DPA-GrowthPay — that will contain the draft addendum once legal has approved it.

Thanks again — happy to coordinate the call.

Best,
